真的会有人翻到这里啊。

感谢你信任我写的应用。如果你懂些代码，大概会发现，整个应用都是 vibe coding 出来的，是我边学边做的小作品。希望我有限的开发能力，能帮你减少一些意外外放的烦恼。

写这个应用，源于一次意外。前一天晚上看赛车直播，我忘了把媒体音量关掉，结果第二天点开好友发来的抽象哈基米视频，就这么外放了出来，当场社死💦 希望有了这个应用，这样的意外能少一些。

总之，欢迎使用声锁。项目已采用 MIT 许可证开源，你可以自由修改，也欢迎分享自己的版本。如果遇到 bug，请到 GitHub 项目页提交 issue，我会尽量及时排查和修复。如果你也想帮忙改进，欢迎提交 PR。

SoundLock uses an accessibility service to receive volume-key events, block volume up while speaker audio is locked, and show the unlock confirmation. It does not read screen content, tap for you, or collect typed text. It only changes media volume, never calls, ringtones or alarms. You can pause protection in SoundLock, or turn the service off here.
Turn on the service to protect speaker audio.

The auto-lock timer starts once playback stops.
Press volume up and confirm to unlock.
No app can open this link

SoundLock needs the accessibility service to receive volume keys and show the unlock prompt. It does not read screen content or collect typed text.\n\nEnable “SoundLock · Volume Guard” in system settings. If the system reports restricted settings, allow them in App info first. You can pause protection or turn the service off at any time.
Restores a low media volume. Auto-locks %1$s after playback stops.
The guard service is not connected. Turn it on again.

While locked, pressing volume up shows a confirmation at the top of the screen; speaker audio only comes back after “Confirm unlock”. You can also unlock from the home screen. Unlocking restores a low media volume, never the previous level. The prompt hides itself on cancel or timeout, and nothing floats on screen the rest of the time.

Auto-locks after %1$s without media playback; time spent playing does not count. Volume back to zero, headphones disconnected, an output change or a service reconnect also lock again. Change the delay in Settings → Auto-lock delay, and add the SoundLock tile to quick settings to lock on demand.
External devices work normally and lock again when you switch back to the phone speaker. SoundLock only protects speaker media audio; it never changes call, ringtone or alarm volume.

The accessibility service receives volume keys and shows the confirmation; it does not read screen content. The status notification carries the lock shortcut. Exact alarms keep the auto-lock timer on time with the screen off; without that permission it can be delayed. On ColorOS, also check background activity and autostart settings.

SoundLock picks the volume control itself. Some OPPO devices restrict background media-volume writes, so it mutes through the accessibility volume channel tied to media instead. If a separate screen-reader volume channel is enabled, it uses the standard media interface. On the compatibility channel the reported volume is an estimate: the floor is not proof of silence.

An ordinary app cannot guarantee an absolute silence. If the system or another app raises the volume, SoundLock mutes again as fast as it can; if the service is stopped, it cannot protect anything. The top prompt is drawn by SoundLock itself and is not integrated with OPPO Fluid Cloud.
Everything happens on this device. No network or microphone permission, no recording, no screen capture.
Could not read the audio state. Turn protection off and on again.
Muting media; silence is not confirmed yet.
